rites.name: Meratalum
rites.text: Meratalum is a concept of Ashestith in the Seeding, the time when the makers plant the Weave and quiet powers sleep through the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders. It is remembered as the moment when the sanctified fires were first bound into the ground, so that the powers of later ages could be stilled and shaped. Its meaning is taught in the temple schools as the first lesson of restraint.

rites.name: Ashiastora
rites.text: Ashiastora is the Ember Tithe, a rite in which the first sovereign's heralds burned their oaths into a ring of standing stones during the Sundering. The flare was seen across three neighbouring shards and sealed the Pact that bound the growing kingdoms together.

rites.name: Vanasareno
rites.text: Vanasareno is a concept of the Martial Realm in the Ashestith universe, an idea of disciplined force born during the Fall and the Sundering, when the worlds broke into Shards. It was carried through the Holy Age by orders of flame-bearers who swore the Pact to keep their temples standing.

rites.name: Thithora
rites.text: Thithora is a concept in Ashestith, an idea of the Fall and the Sundering, when worlds broke and the Pact was sworn during the Age of Sundering. It names the moment a shared bond gave way to landfall and the scattering of the Shards. Its meaning shifts with each telling of the Pact.

rites.name: Syusheth
rites.text: Syusheth is a martial art and bodily discipline in Ashestith, where practitioners harden flesh into a dense, rust-colored alloy through years of forge-work and breath. Its masters are drawn from the guild-cities of the Third Age and are sworn to defend workers' districts from cataclysmic raiders. Their greatest technique is said to absorb and redirect the force of a falling mountain.

rites.name: Thiseshora
rites.text: Thiseshora is a standing defense apparatus of the Ashestith realm's Martial order, formed from a coalition of seven valley republics to answer raiding monsters and sky-borne sorcerers. Its soldiers carry hand-forged rifles, pistols, and rotary guns, and its armored hulls, called cinderwains, rumble across the highlands after every alarm bell.

rites.name: Syushora
rites.text: Syushora is a tidal warden of the Ashestith deep reaches, a fin-crowned guardian whose body endures the crushing trenches and whose song calls the sea into obedience. Its people are said to have once bent entire currents against the coastal kingdoms of a drowned age.

rites.name: Zephistasha
rites.text: Zephistasha is a silver-armored duelist whose strikes carry the weight of a sunset falling into the sea, though she has never once lifted a blade against a civilian. Those who serve beside her say she can halt a tide of oncoming steel with a single raised palm, and that her quiet tread is heard before any battle cry. She serves as a shield for the lawful when reckless titans would burn the streets down.

rites.name: Thathyss
rites.text: Thathyss is a quiet, grief-bound support circle in Ashestith where those who lost partners to a dangerous calling gather to speak their sorrow aloud. Its members teach one another that love outlasts the danger that took their companions. The circle is also a place where old wounds and unresolved accusations are slowly brought into the light.

rites.name: Xaessith
rites.text: Xaessith is a sovereign war-forge of the Martial realm, a fortress-city of dueling-engines that drinks the heat of its own forging furnaces. Its founders bound their smiths into a guild of steel and fire, and the guild has never lost a single contest of arms. Its sentinels can unmake a stone bulwark in a single strike.

rites.name: Asheshora
rites.text: Asheshora is a silent storm-kite of the Martial realm that drifts above the glass-dunes of Ashestith, hunting the thermal breath of sleeping titans. When it dives, it folds the air around it into a single rope of lightning that can pierce the crust of a mountain.

rites.name: Osavsora
rites.text: Osavsora is a drifting lattice of wind-carved sky-reefs that hangs above the Ashestith plains, where tradition-bound duelists train by riding its updrafts. Its lightning-stored winds can be unleashed in a single gust that flattens entire valleys, though the reefs themselves are fragile and rarely weathered in full.

rites.name: Ashasith
rites.text: Ashasith is a fortress-world of the Ashestith in the Martial realm, a people who once bound their star-forges into a single warding chorus. Seven ages ago they sealed their skies behind a veil of silence, and its keepers still refuse all signals that come from outside their orbit.

rites.name: Isyuzeth
rites.text: Isyuzeth is a fractured war-anthem woven from the resonance of a dying skyline, a sound that can rattle the bones of a city district when it is sung at full volume. In the Martial realm of Ashestith it serves as both a rallying cry for displaced mountain clans and a weapon that turns rubble into a steady drumbeat of defiance.

rites.name: Ilolamira
rites.text: Ilolamira is a concept of Ashestith, the idea that a single decision can fork the world into three futures held apart by the Library's shelves. Born in the Age of Sundering, when landfall split old allegiances, it became a name for the choice between paths that cannot be walked together.
